messages:
anya: Quick sync  ACME/Beta asked for a 'cheap mode' preset in the Console. They want a simple productized knob, not a dev-only flag. Can we scope this by EOW?

mike: What does "cheap mode" mean exactly? pure quantize, lower max tokens, smaller model, or routing?

lee: From research: customers usually expect 3 levers: model size, quantization, and prompt truncation/caching. Each has different quality impact.

sophia: Sales says ACME will pilot if we ship a 1-click preset in Console + API param. They want to see cost drop >=40%.

ram: Ops note: exposing 1-click in hosted API requires per-account rollout + telemetry. infra effort ~2 sprints, plus safety rollouts.

jen: Product options: A) Minimal preset: map to existing kernel flags + doc (fast). B) Full preset: GUI, per-route controls, auto-fallback, and eval gating (bigger). C) Enterprise-only: surface knob only for Dedicated/Private.

anya: Key constraints: 1) Launch criteria must include eval pass on our 200-prompt ACME set, 2) telemetry for regression alarm, 3) per-account opt-in.

mike: Risk: if we enable on hosted by default we could see SLO regressions. We should default OFF and do gradual canary.

lee: Quick metric suggestion: evaluate on coherence@longctx, hallucination rate, and latency p95. Baseline -> cheap preset delta.

sophia: Messaging: "Tiered cost presets" not "AutoQuantize". Emphasize quality safeguards.

ram: Can we do a hybrid ship: Console preset + API query param, behind account feature flag, and a server-side canary routing?

jen: Timeline ask: if infra + runtime commit to 2 sprints, research can produce eval & recommendations in 4 business days, docs/GTM another 3. Overall ~3 weeks full ship for minimal preset.

anya: Prioritization: is ACME pilot urgent enough to tradeoff other Q2 work? what's the expected ARR impact?

sophia: ACME pilot alone is ~200k ARR within 6 months if successful. Sales pressure is real.

mike: Also consider long-term maint cost: adding presets proliferates variants we must keep tested. We need a maintenance plan.

lee: Proposal: ship Minimal preset (A) to hosted as opt-in behind feature flag, with canary + eval gating. Parallel spike to prototype selective-FP attention to reduce quality loss (future).

jen: Acceptable launch criteria (proposed): eval delta in hallucination <= +5% vs baseline, latency p95 increase <= 20ms, cost reduction >=35% on sample workload, and feature-flagged canary rollout path.

ram: I'll add rollout steps to infra backlog and include auto-disable if telemetry alarms trigger.

deploy-bot: created issue #3421: "tiered-cost-preset: infra canary + feature-flagging" by ram. CI pipeline created.

anya: Decision: prioritize Minimal preset behind flag. Workplan owners: mike (infra), lee (eval), jen (product), sophia (GTM).

mike: I'll scope infra tasks and return estimates by EOD tomorrow.

lee: I'll share the 200-prompt ACME eval set and initial results in the RFC.

jen: RFC template coming in 6h, will call for review.

sophia: I'll draft customer FAQ and pre-approved positioning language for Sales.

anya: Good. Keep discussion here. If any blocking technical unknowns surface, escalate to eng runtime.

sophia: +1. thanks team :rocket:
